content: Differentiating Lightning/BTC gift card features: no KYC/no account for redemption (Azteco), guest-friendly LNURL-w claim, Bitcoin-native (borderless, censorship-resistant), instant settlement (vs 22-min email avg), partial spend/partial balance (btc-giftcard), nostr wallet connect integration (coin-gift), multi-recipient single gift with random/average split (LN Gift), NFC tap-to-redeem (Bolt Cards), CSV bulk import with per-recipient amounts (not widely implemented), printable PDF/SVG physical-style cards, hold invoice pattern (funds in sender wallet until claimed). Most Lightning gift card products lack: email delivery with image, design templates, per-recipient metadata tracking, CSV import.
